quotes.quote: "It felt odd leaving the neighborhood without one of our cars, but knowing it was safe elsewhere gave us peace of mind. We could focus on getting out without worrying about what we were leaving behind." -- Owner of 2 Cars
"We tried to leave one car parked safely, but when the fire got close, we just panicked and took both. It slowed us down in traffic, but thankfully we made it." -- Owner of 2 Cars

"Leaving one car felt strange, but with just the essentials, we moved quickly and avoided most of the traffic. Knowing we could focus on getting to safety rather than worrying about the extra car was a relief." -- Owner of 2 Cars
"We just couldn't leave one of the cars, so we took both. The streets were packed, and it was nerve-wracking, but thankfully, we were able to stay together." -- Owner of 2 Cars
"We decided to take both cars so each of us could bring what we needed. It slowed us down a bit in the evacuation, but we felt better having everything with us." -- Owner of 2 Cars

"It was hard to leave the kids, but the school was a safe place. I trusted the staff and focused on getting us ready at home. Knowing they were safe gave me one less thing to worry about." -- Worried Parents

"We planned to leave them at school, but I just couldn't. I rushed over, picked them up, and got caught in traffic on the way back. It was a tough decision, but I couldn't stand the thought of being separated." -- Worried Parents

"I didn't want to take any chances, so I went to get them as soon as I could. It took a bit longer with everyone on the road, but we made it back together, and it was worth the peace of mind." -- Worried Parents

"I thought about getting them, but we waited. The school kept them safe, and we were able to prepare the house and pack our things in the meantime. In the end, I'm glad we didn't risk getting stuck in traffic." -- Worried Parents
"We held off on making any moves. I was nervous, and we ended up leaving in a panic without a plan." -- Worried Parents
"Leaving early was tough, but knowing we had a head start on everyone else made it worth it. It wasn't easy to leave the house behind, but safety comes first." -- WUI Resident
"We thought we had more time. In the end, it was a close call, and it reminded us just how dangerous it is to live out here. Next time, we won't risk it." -- WUI Resident
"Investing in our home's defenses has been worth it. We know it's not foolproof, but at least we're giving our place a fighting chance if a fire comes close." -- WUI Resident
"It was too expensive to do upgrades and we thought everything would work out okay, but now we are devastated to have lost our house." -- WUI Resident

"We decided to wait and see but things got out of hand so quickly. We are relieved that emergency responders were available to help us, but we know next time we might not be so lucky." -- WUI Resident
